SELECT CASE WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (1,7,13,19) THEN 'marea sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (6,12,18,24) THEN 'puerto sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (2,8,14,20) THEN 'dique sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (3,9,15,21) THEN 'pilotaje sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (4,10,16,22) THEN 'francos sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (5,11,17,23) THEN 'ordenes/acc/enf/bajas'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 25 THEN 'paga mensual'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 26 THEN 'SAC'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 27 THEN 'vacaciones'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 28 THEN 'anticipos'_x000A_ ELSE 'fuera de la tabla (dia ' + CAST(DAY([Fecha]) AS varchar(2)) + ')' END paga,_x000A_ COUNT(*) novedades, COUNT(DISTINCT [Cód_ Concepto]) conceptos_x000A_FROM [ArbuTest$Novedad Liquidación$d4f5a6b7-c8d9-4e0f-a1b2-c3d4e5f67890]_x000A_GROUP BY CASE WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (1,7,13,19) THEN 'marea sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (6,12,18,24) THEN 'puerto sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (2,8,14,20) THEN 'dique sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (3,9,15,21) THEN 'pilotaje sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (4,10,16,22) THEN 'francos sem 1-4'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) IN (5,11,17,23) THEN 'ordenes/acc/enf/bajas'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 25 THEN 'paga mensual'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 26 THEN 'SAC'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 27 THEN 'vacaciones'_x000A_ WHEN DAY([Fecha]) = 28 THEN 'anticipos'_x000A_ ELSE 'fuera de la tabla (dia ' + CAST(DAY([Fecha]) AS varchar(2)) + ')' END_x000A_ORDER BY 2 DESC
